potential_function_and_limit: Microvascular exchange and transport; Cd36/Fabp4-associated lipid-handling programs are hypotheses from RNA, not measured transport.
Endocardial/chamber-lining-associated signaling and interface programs; actual chamber-wall location requires spatial/histological validation.
Arterial specification and endothelial coupling-associated program; arteriole anatomy is not proven from RNA alone.
Candidate venous/venular specification; Nr2f2/Ephb4 can overlap other developing ECs and Vwf is not vein-specific.
Candidate lymphatic specification and fluid-drainage biology; require endothelial identity plus Prox1/Flt4, not Lyve1 alone.
